svg.title: Spark-X2.6-4B inference speed
svg.desc: Prefill and decode throughput across 4K, 32K, 128K and 256K context lengths. Two separate test groups. Higher is better. Missing measurements are omitted. Test group 2 hardware: Mac M5 Pro, 16-core.

g.text: Missing measurements are omitted. Each test group uses its own throughput scale.
